name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: A Central Sector scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across India to supplement their financial needs for agricultural inputs and domestic requirements.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.title: Direct Income Support
benefits.description: Financial benefit of Rs 6,000 per year payable in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs 2,000 each.

benefits.title: Direct Benefit Transfer
benefits.description: Funds are transferred directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of beneficiary farmers without intermediaries.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be an operational farmer / agricultural cultivator.
Applicant or farmer family must hold cultivable agricultural land in their name in state land records.
Applicant or any family member must NOT have paid income tax in the last assessment year (Exclusion Criteria).

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Mandatory identity verification card seeded with mobile number for e-KYC.

required_documents.name: Land Ownership Records
required_documents.description: Khasra/Khatauni or Record of Rights (RoR / 7/12 extract) showing clear cultivable land ownership.

required_documents.name: Active Bank Account Passbook
required_documents.description: Bank account linked with Aadhaar and enabled for NPCI Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB).
required_documents.issuing_authority: Any Scheduled Commercial / Regional Rural Bank

application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) and navigate to 'Farmers Corner'.
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' and enter your Aadhaar number and state.
Fill in personal details, land parcel identification (survey number, dag/khasra number, and area).
Upload verified land record documents and submit the self-registration form.
Complete mandatory OTP-based or biometric e-KYC on the portal or via Common Service Centre (CSC).

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: The world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing comprehensive cashless hospitalization cover for vulnerable families in secondary and tertiary care.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority

benefits.title: Cashless Hospitalization Cover
benefits.description: Free medical coverage up to Rs 5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis across empanelled public and private hospitals nationwide.

benefits.title: Pre and Post Hospitalization Expenses
benefits.description: Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization diagnostics and medicines.

eligibility_rules.description: Targeted at families belonging to deprived socio-economic categories as per SECC 2011 or NFSA state ration card thresholds.
Family living in kuccha/temporary shelter or deprived conditions without ownership of a high-value urban house.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card or Government Photo ID
required_documents.description: For individual biometric identification at hospital helpdesk.

required_documents.name: Ration Card or Family Identification Document
required_documents.description: NFSA Ration Card or Samagra / State Family ID proving household composition.

application_steps: Check your family eligibility online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in using mobile number, Aadhaar, or Ration Card.
If eligible, visit any empanelled public or private hospital or nearest CSC/Arogya Mitra desk.
Present your Aadhaar card and Ration card for e-KYC verification.
Receive your official Ayushman Card (Golden Card) for instant cashless treatment.
source_title: National Health Authority - Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Official Portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
description: A flagship Mission by the Government of India providing all-weather pucca houses to all eligible urban households including slum dwellers, EWS, and LIG categories.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

benefits.title: Interest Subsidy & Construction Grant
benefits.description: Central assistance of Rs 1.5 Lakh under Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) or interest subsidy under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).

benefits.title: Basic Civic Infrastructure
benefits.description: Houses built with attached toilet, water supply, electricity connection, and kitchen space.

eligibility_rules.description: The beneficiary family must NOT own a pucca (all-weather concrete) house either in their name or in any family member's name anywhere in India.
Household annual income must fall within Economically Weaker Section (EWS, up to Rs 3 Lakh) or Low Income Group (LIG, up to Rs 6 Lakh).

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card of all Family Members
required_documents.description: Biometric identity proof for household deduplication.

required_documents.name: Income Certificate or Form 16 / Salary Slips
required_documents.description: Proof of household annual income below qualifying limits.

required_documents.name: Land / House Plot Ownership Document
required_documents.description: For Beneficiary Led Construction: Registered sale deed or Patta showing ownership of plot.

application_steps: Visit the official PMAY portal (pmaymis.gov.in) under Citizen Assessment.
Choose your category: 'For Slum Dwellers' or 'Benefit under other 3 components'.
Verify with your Aadhaar number and applicant name as per Aadhaar.
Fill in personal, bank account, household income, and existing housing status details.
Submit and take printout of the application assessment acknowledgment number for municipal verification.
source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs - PMAY Guidelines

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Provides collateral-free institutional micro-credit up to Rs 10 Lakh (expanded up to Rs 20 Lakh) to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises for income-generating activities.
ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services

benefits.title: Collateral-Free Institutional Loan
benefits.description: Loans without requirement of mortgaged property across three tiers: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 Lakh), and Tarun (Rs 5 Lakh to Rs 10 Lakh).

benefits.title: Mudra Debit Card
benefits.description: Provides working capital overdraft facility for seamless digital raw material procurement.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
Must operate or plan to launch a non-farm micro enterprise, manufacturing unit, trading shop, or service business.

required_documents.name: Proof of Identity & Address
required_documents.description: Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN card, or Driving License.

required_documents.name: Business Project Plan / Quotation
required_documents.description: Details of machinery to purchase, anticipated cash flow, and cost of enterprise expansion.

required_documents.name: Bank Statement (Past 6 Months)
required_documents.description: Showing financial transactions and creditworthiness.

application_steps: Prepare a basic business plan stating equipment costs, working capital needs, and revenue projections.
Choose loan category: Shishu (initial setup), Kishore (growing shop), or Tarun (established enterprise).
Apply online through the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank or MFI branch.
Submit completed MUDRA application form along with KYC and equipment quotation documents.
Upon sanction, receive loan disbursement and MUDRA debit card.
source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA) Charter

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
description: Centrally Sponsored Scheme to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

benefits.title: Full Compulsory Tuition Fee Reimbursement
benefits.description: 100% non-refundable fees (tuition, library, examination, sports fees) credited directly to institution or student account.

benefits.title: Monthly Academic Maintenance Allowance
benefits.description: Academic allowance ranging from Rs 2,500 to Rs 13,500 per annum depending on course group (Degree/Professional/Diploma).

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be enrolled as a regular student in a recognized post-matric course (Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, UG, PG, Ph.D.).
Student must belong to a notified Scheduled Caste community.
Total combined family annual income from all sources must NOT exceed Rs 2.50 Lakh per annum.

required_documents.name: Caste Certificate (SC)
required_documents.description: Valid digitally signed caste certificate in applicant's name issued by competent revenue authority.

required_documents.name: Income Certificate
required_documents.description: Current annual income certificate for parents/guardians.

required_documents.name: Bonafide Student Certificate & Fee Receipt
required_documents.description: Issued by the college/university confirming current enrollment and fee schedule.

required_documents.name: Previous Year Marksheet
required_documents.description: Passing mark certificate of Matriculation (Class 10) or qualifying examination.

application_steps: Visit the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) and register for an OTR (One Time Registration).
Login with OTR credentials and select 'Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students'.
Select your college/institution from the AISHE/DISE registered list.
Upload caste certificate, income certificate, and previous year academic marksheet.
Submit application for online verification by your College Nodal Officer (INO) and District Nodal Officer (DNO).
source_title: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment - Post-Matric Scholarship Guidelines

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: A Central Sector micro-credit scheme launched to empower urban street vendors by providing collateral-free working capital loans and incentivizing digital transactions.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

benefits.title: Graduated Working Capital Credit
benefits.description: First tranche loan of Rs 10,000; on timely repayment eligible for second tranche of Rs 20,000, and third tranche up to Rs 50,000.

benefits.title: 7% Interest Subsidy & Digital Cashback
benefits.description: Early or timely repayment receives 7% p.a. interest subsidy credited directly to bank account, plus up to Rs 1,200 annual cashback on digital QR payments.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Must be engaged in vending goods, services, food, or apparel in urban or surrounding rural areas.

required_documents.name: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Vendor ID Card
required_documents.description: Issued by the Urban Local Body (ULB) / Town Vending Committee (TVC), or Letter of Recommendation (LoR).

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Linked to active mobile number for digital application validation.

required_documents.name: Bank Account Details / Passbook
required_documents.description: Account in any commercial bank, regional rural bank, or cooperative bank.

application_steps: Verify your vendor status or obtain a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from your local municipality / TVC.
Go to the PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) and click 'Apply for Loan'.
Authenticate with your Aadhaar-linked mobile OTP.
Select the preferred lending institution and submit the loan request.
Bank verifies and disburses the credit directly into your bank account.
source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs - PM SVANidhi Guidelines

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: A Government of India backed small-deposit savings scheme targeted at parents of girl children under the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign, offering sovereign guarantees and tax exemptions.
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts

benefits.title: High Sovereign Interest Rate
benefits.description: One of the highest government savings interest rates (~8.2% per annum, compounded annually).

benefits.title: Triple Tax Exemption (EEE)
benefits.description: Deposits qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C, interest earned is tax-free, and maturity withdrawal is completely exempt from income tax.

eligibility_rules.description: The child for whom the account is opened must be female.
The girl child must not have attained 10 years of age on the date of account opening.

required_documents.name: Birth Certificate of Girl Child
required_documents.description: Official birth certificate issued by municipal body or registrar of births.

required_documents.name: Identity & Residence Proof of Guardian
required_documents.description: Aadhaar card, PAN card, or Passport of biological or legal guardian.

application_steps: Collect Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form (Form-1) from any Post Office or authorized commercial bank.
Attach child's birth certificate and guardian's KYC identity and address proof documents.
Deposit the minimum initial opening amount (minimum Rs 250, maximum Rs 1.5 Lakh per fiscal year).
Collect the SSY passbook with unique account number for subsequent deposits and tracking.
source_title: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications - Sukanya Samriddhi Rules

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
description: A major state initiative by the Government of Madhya Pradesh to foster economic self-reliance, nutritional security, and decision-making power for women in the state.
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh

benefits.title: Monthly Direct Financial Assistance
benefits.description: Rs 1,250 deposited directly every month on the 10th into the beneficiary's individual DBT-enabled bank account.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh state.
Must be female (married, widowed, divorced, or deserted).
Age must be between 21 and 60 completed years as of January 1 of the calendar year.
Combined family annual income must be less than Rs 2.50 Lakh.
No member of the applicant's family must be an income tax payer.

required_documents.name: Samagra Family ID & Member ID
required_documents.description: 9-digit individual Samagra ID with active e-KYC linked to Aadhaar.
required_documents.issuing_authority: Panchayat & Rural Development / Urban Administration MP

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card with Mobile Linkage
required_documents.description: Must have updated biometric and active mobile OTP.

required_documents.name: Individual DBT-enabled Bank Account
required_documents.description: Personal bank account linked to Aadhaar NPCI mapper for Direct Benefit Transfer.

application_steps: Ensure Samagra e-KYC is completed and bank account is NPCI-seeded for DBT.
Attend designated Gram Panchayat / Ward Level camp or CSC in Madhya Pradesh.
Officials register application on cmladlibehna.mp.gov.in using biometric / mobile OTP authentication.
Receive printed acknowledgment receipt and verify provisional list published at Gram Panchayat.
source_title: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana Portal
